authored_scope: Random scenes are 12..30 per side by default, and explicit random sizes of 10..30 are accepted. Non-square grids are supported. Each scene has 2..6 patches in distinct corner/edge slots, with the cap depending on the shorter side. Patch sizes are random, and some patches are elongated. Each patch gets 1..3 turn-penalised corridors to the hub. Branches of different patches can touch diagonally at hub corners. All four colours are random and distinct. Sizes above the fixtures and 6-patch scenes are synthetic extensions. Deliberately not supported: patches with more than two colours in random mode, a hub not made of line colour, branches that touch two patches, centre ties, and branches disconnected from the hub.
authored_constraints: Exactly one solid 3x3 block of line colour (the hub) per input.
Each 4-connected non-hub line component touches exactly one patch interior and is 4-adjacent to the hub.
Branches of different patches are never 4-adjacent. Their only diagonal contacts are across hub corners.
Every patch has a strict majority colour, and both patch colours win at least one branch in random mode.
The hub centre's branch-cell count has a unique maximum.
Background count > line count > count of each patch colour, so background and line detection by frequency or largest object is unambiguous.
Patches and their frames keep a gap of at least 2 from each other and from the hub.
All retries are bounded: 12 placement tries per slot and 400 scene attempts. The contrast requirement is dropped after 200 attempts.
